headline: coordination-free convergence + ~92% less data moved

convergence_gate.name: convergence
convergence_gate.required: replicas reach identical state with no coordinator / consensus
convergence_gate.detail: any node, any order, after any partition -> identical merged state (the same byte-identical property proven on silicon)

data_moved_gate.name: data_moved
data_moved_gate.detail: ~92% less at ~5% of state changed per tick — scales with change density, not a universal multiplier

provenance.data_moved_note: Measured on the AX7020 ATOMiK adapter: an edge-telemetry sync tick moved 160 B vs 2,048 B of full state, with exact 64-bit LOAD/ACCUM/READ round-trips on a falsification-tested harness.

scope_note: The data-moved ratio is for ~5% of state changed per tick; it scales with how much of the state changes per tick — lower change density means a larger reduction, higher means smaller. It is not a universal multiplier.
